0022600131.text: The Portland Trail Blazers, 2-0 and winners of two straight, visit the Los Angeles Lakers, who are also 2-0 and undefeated at home, in Portland's third game of the season. Shaedon Sharpe is out after knee surgery, and Branden Carlson (concussion) and Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while the Lakers will be without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain). Portland won the last meeting 132-116 in Portland on January 17, 2026, and took the 2025-26 season series 2-1, with no games between the teams yet in 2026-27.
